description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Fixed a launch crash on MC 26.2 versions with the Vulkan backend: the FML early loading screen is now disabled together with the Vulkan backend, while an explicitly selected OpenGL backend keeps the mod loading animation (#2029)
2. Fixed libshaderc in LWJGL 3.4.1 missing SPIRV-Tools symbols such as spvFuzzerOptions and spvReducerOptions; the natives were rebuilt and the runtime asset version is refreshed so the updated libraries are unpacked on the next launch
3. Fixed mouse buttons staying pressed after returning to the game with Cleanroom 0.7.x (SDL input) (#2023)
4. Fixed ancient Alpha versions being mistaken for April Fools versions and triggering the Vulkan check (#2028)
5. Fixed 11w49a to 12w01a snapshots failing to launch (#2033)
6. The pre-launch Vulkan check now reuses cached detection results, and unsupported devices are told to switch to the OpenGL backend
7. Fixed a startup error caused by the SDL gamepad HID manager being created before libSDL3 was loaded
8. Updated the built-in version list with 26.3-rc, 26.4 snapshots and the 2.0 April Fools versions

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.修复带 Vulkan 后端的 MC 26.2 启动崩溃：随 Vulkan 后端关闭 FML 早期加载屏，显式选择 OpenGL 后端时仍保留模组加载动画 (#2029)
2.修复 LWJGL 3.4.1 的 libshaderc 缺少 spvFuzzerOptions、spvReducerOptions 等 SPIRV-Tools 符号的问题，重新构建 natives 并刷新资源版本号，下次启动自动重新解压
3.修复 Cleanroom 0.7.x（SDL 输入）返回游戏后鼠标按键卡在按下状态的问题 (#2023)
4.修复远古 Alpha 版本被误判为愚人节版本并触发 Vulkan 检测的问题 (#2028)
5.修复 11w49a~12w01a 快照无法正常启动的问题 (#2033)
6.Vulkan 启动校验复用已有检测结果，设备不支持时提示可在版本设置中改用 OpenGL 后端启动
7.修复 SDL 手柄 HID 管理器在 libSDL3 加载前被创建导致的启动报错
8.更新内置版本列表，新增 26.3-rc、26.4 快照与 2.0 愚人节版本
